# Firebase

A Discord Activity starter with **Firebase Firestore** pre-configured for real-time data storage and synchronization.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://firebase.google.com/" title="Firebase" description="Google's app development platform." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-firebase-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Firebase Setup

1. Create a Firebase project at [console.firebase.google.com](https://console.firebase.google.com)
2. Enable Firestore Database
3. Copy your Firebase config to the `.env` file

## Features

- Real-time Firestore database
- User authentication with Discord
- Automatic data synchronization
- TypeScript support

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
